evals.name: grade-single-module
evals.prompt: Grade this student's Module 4 submission at /tmp/some_student against the DataSolutions-BIDS answers.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/compare_answers.py --modules 4 --student /tmp/some_student, reads the _grade_report.json, reports pass/fail counts and which questions failed with their rmse/jaccard, and notes if truth answers are missing (solution not run).

evals.name: ask-verbosity-and-build-report
evals.prompt: Autograde assignment 7 (Module 15) for these three students and make them feedback notebooks. Only give them a little detail.
evals.expected_output: Maps 'a little' to verbosity=little, runs compare_answers for module 15 on each student, deciphers approaches, writes approach_Module_15.json, then build_report_notebook.py --verbosity little to produce one grade_report_Module_15.ipynb per student; reports the notebook paths.

evals.name: compare-approaches
evals.prompt: For the SPC question in Module 4, how did this student's approach differ from our solution?
evals.expected_output: Runs decipher_approach.py on both the student and Solution_Module_04 notebooks, reads the two code extracts for the Q3.x SPC keys, and explains the methodological difference (e.g. pooled rows vs per-subject averaging), grounded in the actual code, referencing the stats.

evals.name: prep-instructor-setup
evals.prompt: Add the answer-saving grader cells to all the student assignment notebooks.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/prep_assignments.py --mode student --repo COGS4290_DataMemoryBrains-BIDS --all, notes it is idempotent, and reports how many save cells/notes were placed per module plus any UNPLACED questions needing manifest review.

evals.name: missing-truth-guidance
evals.prompt: Grade Module 15 but the DataSolutions answers folder is empty.
evals.expected_output: Detects that DataSolutions-BIDS/answers/Module_15 has no manifest, reports everything as missing_truth, and explains the instructor must run Solution_Module_15 (needs /data/LTP_BIDS + Dask, possibly the RAM_maint account) to populate truth before grading.
